obligations.title: Domain fidelity
obligations.quantified_statement: For every admitted current-tranche operation/history constructor, the canonical source maps to the frozen physical domain without unapproved semantic loss.
premises: MC-A current-tranche domain lock is accepted
the MC-002/003 constructor and exact-source contracts are unchanged

obligations.title: Sweep semantics
obligations.quantified_statement: For every admitted cutter/setup/motion instance, actual engaged tool sweep semantics equal the material-removal operation defined by the canonical source.
premises: all relevant motion correlation and engagement/end-point semantics are preserved

obligations.title: Closure under finite composition
obligations.quantified_statement: For every finite physically valid admitted history, applying its operations and setup transitions in journal order yields a defined material/body state with no dropped operation or body.
premises: setup transitions preserve declared frames/body identity

obligations.title: Sound classification
obligations.quantified_statement: For every required material/event query generated by an admitted finite history, inside/outside/boundary and equality/root decisions are sound, including exact-zero, multiple-root and singular cases.
premises: the arithmetic/event branch used has a proved decision precondition

obligations.title: Finite progress
obligations.quantified_statement: For every required query and realization step, the selected constructive route terminates with a certified result under the frozen semantics; any explicit proof blocker keeps PO-05 OPEN, and timeout, iteration caps or provider cycling are not semantic success.
premises: each successful refinement branch has an input-derived finite stopping witness

obligations.title: Checkable error certification
obligations.quantified_statement: For every nonempty realized result at an admitted accuracy request, a checker can verify the composed geometric error bound from source decoding through reconstruction without compensating for topology/material/body errors.
premises: every numeric-error transfer is monotone and source-bound

obligations.title: Topology/connectivity
obligations.quantified_statement: For every material state produced by an admitted finite history, connectivity, components, protected positive-volume features and durable body/lineage semantics are correct.
premises: topology is decided independently of numeric tolerance

obligations.title: Complete dispatch
obligations.quantified_statement: For every admitted required query, provider dispatch selects a semantics-preserving terminating successful route without retry cycling, denominator shrinkage or operation substitution; any named unresolved blocker keeps PO-08 OPEN.
premises: provider admission conditions are checkable sufficient conditions

obligations.title: Conventional engineering realization
obligations.quantified_statement: For every required nominal material/body state, including singular and grouped cases, the construction yields finite conventional usable engineering geometry satisfying the frozen output contract; any unresolved realization obligation keeps PO-09 OPEN.
premises: output profile and body mapping are fixed prospectively

obligations.title: STEP preservation
obligations.quantified_statement: For every qualified engineering result, exact-profile STEP write/read and independent engineering use preserve certified geometry, topology and body mapping within the frozen request.
premises: the qualified consumer path is independent of candidate self-verdicts

obligations.title: Implementation refinement
obligations.quantified_statement: For every implemented authority-path function used by MC-1, observable behavior refines its reviewed construction/certificate contract on all admitted inputs.

obligations.title: Resource accounting
obligations.quantified_statement: For every preregistered qualification workload and completed final repeat, elapsed time, peak memory, threads/workers, refusals and failures are truthfully accounted against the frozen resource envelope.
